args.topic: Gratitude for close companions as a gentle bedtime practice
args.persona: A calm, warm guided-gratitude meditation channel: gentle female guide, unhurried, speaking softly to one listener.
args.scriptExcerpt:
You spend so many waking hours pouring your energy into the world... Now, it is time to rest.

[softly] Your mind holds onto the faces and voices you encountered today... the demands, the conversations, the passing moments... [pause] Tonight, on day four of our practice, we gently release the strangers... and draw close the warmth of the people beside you... the ones who simply let you be... [long pause] Breathe in their quiet acceptance... let it soften your jaw, your neck, your chest... as my voice guides you into the deepest sanctuary of sleep...

Welcome to Gratitude Springs. If you have carried the friction of a hundred hurried interactions with you to this moment... give yourself permission to set it down. Tonight, we will simply breathe and find our way back to peace.
